Watch the market show its hand.
BananaPatterns Risk first, always.

Breakouts

Every breakout at the liquidity floor, across all screens — the last five trading days.

Learn

How BananaPatterns works?

We run a handful of screens — each hunts a different kind of setup. Pick one to see its anatomy — what it looks for, and why.

The anatomy of a breakout

How we narrow the market down

The trade, once it triggers

Cut losers fast, let winners run

Risk is decided before entry — about 1.5% of capital on any one trade. From there it's calm and consistent: protect first, then give a winner room to breathe.

Course · coming soon Want to really learn this, step by step?

We're thinking of building a proper course — the full playbook, real worked examples, and how to actually run it without losing your shirt. We'll only build it if enough people want it. Tell us you're in.

⚖️
It's probabilities, not predictions. BananaPatterns is wrong more often than it's right — it wins on roughly 1 in 3 trades. It works because the few winners are far larger than the many small, capped losses. That asymmetry is the entire edge — and it only shows up over many trades, through real drawdowns.

About us

Chart structure, measured — every stock, every close.

BananaPatterns is a stock screening and market analytics tool. It measures how every liquid company listed in India is trading: the bases they build, the breakouts that follow, and the ones that fail. The method is published in full, tested against years of market history, and reported with its losses shown beside its gains. We do not sell tips or recommendations.

A base either meets the published definition or it does not, and the same test runs across the whole market after every close — no names chosen by hand, no results selected after the fact. Software does the scanning because no one can read four thousand charts a night.

The thinking it encodes is not new: be patient while a stock builds, act when it proves itself, cut a mistake quickly, and give the rare idea that works enough room to matter. What we add is consistency, and a record you can check.

Rules, not opinions

One published test, applied to every stock alike. Nothing hand-picked, nothing added with hindsight.

The complete record

Breakouts that failed are shown beside those that worked. A method's losses are part of describing it honestly.

Measurement, not advice

We are not SEBI-registered advisers and make no recommendations. What we publish is measurement and method.

BananaPatterns is a stock screening, charting and market-analytics platform for Indian equities, and a personal record of one individual's rules-based approach to studying the stock market. All content — the methodology, backtests, screens, charts, and the live book — is provided for information purposes only.

Not investment advice

Nothing on this site is investment advice, a research report, a recommendation, or a solicitation to buy, sell, or hold any security. BananaPatterns is not registered with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) as an Investment Adviser or a Research Analyst, and does not provide personalised investment advice. We do not know your financial situation, objectives, or risk tolerance.

Backtests are hypothetical

Historical performance figures shown anywhere on this site are the result of applying a fixed set of rules to past data (a "backtest"). They are hypothetical, were not achieved by trading real money in real time, and are subject to limitations including — but not limited to — survivorship bias, changes in the investable universe over time, and the benefit of hindsight. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

Trading and investing in equities carries a substantial risk of loss and is not suitable for everyone. You may lose some or all of your capital. You alone are responsible for your decisions.

Do your own research

Always conduct your own research and consult a SEBI-registered investment adviser before making any investment decision. Any action you take based on information on this site is strictly at your own risk.

No warranty

Privacy Policy

This policy explains what personal data BananaPatterns ("we") collects and how we handle it, consistent with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).

What we collect

We collect the email address you voluntarily provide to unlock free content or receive updates, along with basic, non-identifying technical information (such as anonymous page views) to keep the Site running. We do not ask for financial account details, passwords, or sensitive personal data.

Why we collect it

To give you access to free content, to send you occasional updates about the method and the Site, and to understand general usage so we can improve. We process your email on the basis of your consent.

What we don't do

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. We do not share it with third parties except trusted service providers that help us operate the Site (for example, email delivery), under appropriate safeguards.

Contact / Grievance

For any privacy request or grievance, contact support@bananapatterns.com. We will respond within a reasonable time.
